en.html:
Chachamaru"So, bhai. How was apun?"
Kageaki"The work is done. You may leave."
Chachamaru"Arre, feedback asked. Dismissal received."
Kageaki"You wished to be useful. You were."
Chachamaru"This is my room."
Kageaki"Then remain. Quietly."
Chachamaru"You really know how to make a girl feel welcome in her own room."
Kageaki"I have not asked you to feel anything."
Chachamaru"Bhai, some courtesy is free."
Kageaki"Then you should be able to supply it."
Kageaki"I require rest."
Kageaki"Do not interfere."
Chachamaru"After putting apun through that whole drill?"
Chachamaru"Brutal fellow."
Kageaki"You welcomed the role."
Chachamaru"The role, yes! Not every file in the castle!"
Kageaki"You were remarkably eager."
Kageaki"I saw no reason to discourage useful enthusiasm."
Chachamaru"Wah."
Chachamaru"Apun has been encouraged to death."
Kageaki"You appear alive enough to complain."
Chachamaru"And you appear pleased with yourself."
Kageaki"The results were satisfactory."
Chachamaru"Then say that first, na."

Her conclusion was correct. I was fully prepared; that alone mattered.

Kageaki Minato had been specialized for the protection of Hikaru Minato.

The impurities were gone. There was a refreshing absence of doubt within me. Even the fact that I had <ruby>formerly<rt>once</rt></ruby> possessed such doubts was becoming difficult to remember.

For the sake of that one desire, I could do anything. Without so much as disturbing the surface of my mind.

Chachamaru"God will come, bhai."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Rubbish."
Chachamaru"Even a new religious sect would improve the sales pitch. No followers with this presentation."
Kageaki"Nevertheless, I shall go along. If that worthless dream is the only hope of keeping Hikaru alive."
Kageaki"If her survival can exist only in fantasy, I shall break reality and install the fantasy in its place."
Kageaki"Whatever this world puts in the way."
Chachamaru"————"
